players.product: Advantage2 annealing quantum computers and dual-rail superconducting gate-model systems (Quantum Circuits)

quarterly_data.signal: D-Wave 10-Q: Quantum Circuits, acquired January 20, 2026, contributed $250 thousand of revenue and a $15,986 thousand net loss from the acquisition date through June 30, 2026. Revenue from U.S. customers was $2,175 thousand in Q2 2026 ($710 thousand a year earlier) and $3,865 thousand in the first half, while German revenue fell to $302 thousand in the first half from $13,990 thousand. Contract liabilities rose to $10,556 thousand from $3,338 thousand at December 31, 2025; first-half purchases of property and equipment were $5,521 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Quantum Circuits revenue $250 thousand since January 20, 2026; U.S. revenue $2,175 thousand in Q2 2026 (from $710 thousand)
